content: पिठरः, -रम् .²1 A pot, pan, boiler (also पिठरी in this sense); पिठरं क्वथदतिमात्रं निजपार्श्वानेव दहतितराम् <ls>Pt. 1. 324</ls>; जठरपिठरी दुष्पूरेयं करोति विडम्बनाम् <ls>Bh. 3. 116</ls>. .²2 A book, a manuscript; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²3 Smearing, plastering; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-रम्@} A churning-stick. .{@-रः@} An addition to a building shaped like a hollow vessel.
